Next action: Measure the reconciled implementation against the acceptance matrix and quality rubric.

## Outcome and boundary

Issue #68 (bug: every Q&A action also logs a session_viewed (redirect back to the session page)) requires real session navigation to log one view, while Q&A actions (including failed validation) and administrator calendar edits followed by redirects must add no false view rows. Source: https://github.com/adventistasia/lead-lab/issues/68.

CHG-54 (Extend the Activity Log to signed-in user activity) already requires preventing duplicate false positives. RQ-11 (Administrative activity logging before launch), RQ-21 (Session detail Q&A), and RQ-14 (Calendar with scheduled events and configurable reminders) cover these existing flows. No new event type, migration, access rule, historical-data rewrite, provider, or production change is in scope. Issue #69 (bug: activity-log prefetch guard checks X-Inertia-Prefetch, but Inertia sends Purpose: prefetch) remains a separate review run.

## Sequence

1. Define the precise Q&A and calendar acceptance and stop at the human Continue checkpoint.
2. Design: trace client action → redirect → GET → view logger; reproduce with `followingRedirects()` and distinguish actual navigation, failed validation, prefetch, and Inertia partial reloads before choosing the smallest fix. Verify installed client behavior rather than assuming partial headers persist across redirects. Record local runtime and open target-environment facts.
3. Build the smallest evidence-backed correction in the appropriate application source and focused `application/source/tests/Feature/UserActivityTest.php` coverage. Document the resulting view semantics in `application/ops/activity-logging.md` if behavior is clarified there.
4. Capture `evidence/activity-log-redirect-exclusion.png` from a local administrator activity-log view with synthetic `.test` accounts and events. Check the final image for personal data, credentials, cookies, tokens, or private URLs. If browser evidence cannot be captured, record the exact blocker before publication.
5. Reconcile the affected source, tests, operations note, PM records, run evidence, and any deployment guidance; Measure acceptance and security before Learn or Publish.

## Verification and rollback

- Focused feature tests must follow successful and failed Q&A redirects and an administrator calendar edit; assert no extra view rows, plus one view for real session/calendar navigation. Check relevant Q&A action events stay intact.
- Run the full PHP test suite, static/frontend checks applicable to touched paths, and `git diff --check`. Measure must pass before any publication.
- Revert only the issue-specific application changes if checks fail. No schema or historical-log change is planned; no production deployment is authorized.

ISS-24 (Q&A and calendar action redirects inflate session and calendar view activity) and ACT-84 (Correct and verify duplicate activity views after Q&A and calendar redirects) track this work. ACT-80 (Verify event attribution and coverage, absence of false prefetch/duplicate entries and sensitive metadata, user/action/date filtering, administrator-only access, and relevant regressions) remains Open for broader checks.
